findings.location: B14 purity test (text 'not' markers); members EO 4948, EO 5248, EO 2460, EO 2780
findings.claim: B14 members have amending as their only operative content (the purity test catches further provisions).
findings.evidence: EO 4948 (csc-annual-reports/texts/EO_4948.txt): 'Those Indians now in the service under the provisions of the paragraphs which are hereby amended or revoked ... may ... be treated as classified. Indians separated without delinquency ... may be reinstated ... without time limit'. EO 4982 (held) amended EO 4948 'so as to become effective April 1, 1929', so a lead dated 1928-08-14 precedes its effect. EO 5248: 'It is further ordered ... that such board will secure from the Personnel Classification Board ... an advisory opinion'. EO 2460: 'It is further ordered that persons already employed in these capacities must establish before the Civil Service Commission that they have the requisite qualifications'. EO 2780: 'The amendment herein provided for shall not be construed to require any person now holding the office of shipping commissioner to pass an examination in order to retain such office.' Ruling P2 applies only when the order's own text shows amending is its only operative content.
findings.fix: Add markers such as 'it is further ordered|now holding|already employed|now in the service under' to the B12-B15 exclusion and to the B15x condition, so these four members go to B15x (open). Recount B14 and B15x.

summary: The doctrine's structure follows rulings P1-P4 and P6. The express-class ends hold up against the held texts: EO 89 'revokes all others' for the pre-1896 rules, and EO 209 replaces the rules of May 6, 1896 'and the amendments thereof'. EO 209 is honestly left open, since no held restatement names it. The named revocations by EO 250, EO 3014 and EO 5459 are verified. Three errors need correction. First, EO 89's date is given as 1897-05-06 throughout the machine form and in parts of the md, when the held text says May 6, 1896; this misassigns EO 90, 93, 94 and 96 to the pre-1896 parent, puts the B09 and B12b interval ends a year late, and leaves the md counts out of step with the engine. Second, EO 7915 is cited at 2 FR 1519 instead of 3 FR 1519. Third, the contradiction disclosure reports 1 flag where the engine reports 37, many of them genuine later amendments. The purity test also lets through at least four B14 orders with further provisions (EO 4948, 5248, 2460, 2780), which should be open. The remaining findings are minor accuracy fixes. No `yes` lead is proposed, and the open branches and gaps are otherwise stated truthfully.
